title: Two-Step Verification
enableDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a verification code in addition to your password.
reauthenticationNotice: After you start, you will sign in again to verify your identity.
scanQrCode: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
saveRecoveryCodes: Save these recovery codes in a safe place. You'll need them if you lose access to your authenticator.
disableWarning: Disabling 2-step verification will make your account less secure.
enterTotpToDisable: Enter verification code from your authenticator app
regenerateWarning: This will invalidate all your existing recovery codes. Make sure to save the new codes.
enterTotpToRegenerate: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app

errors.regenerateFailed: Failed to regenerate recovery codes. Please try again.
errors.sendCodeFailed: Failed to send the email verification code. Please try again.
errors.invalidOrExpiredCode: The code is invalid, expired, or has reached its attempt limit. Request a new code and try again.
errors.webAuthnNotSupported: WebAuthn not supported by your browser
errors.mandatoryMfaEnforced: Cannot remove the last MFA method when MFA is mandatory.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.description: Use passkeys to sign in to your account with biometrics or a security key.
passkey.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this passkey? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.
passkey.requiresMfa: You must enable TOTP or Email MFA first
passkey.nonCompliantWarning: Your passkeys may be revoked if you don't enable MFA. The security policy requires MFA for passkey authentication.

emailMfaDescription: Receive a verification code via email when signing in
emailSetupDescription: We'll send a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it here before email verification is enabled.
emailCodeSent: A verification code was sent. It expires in 10 minutes.
emailCodeHelp: Enter the complete 6-digit code from the email.
allDisabledDescription: The administrator has disabled all multi-factor authentication methods for this system.
gracePeriodMessage: You have {days} days left to set up two-step verification before it becomes required.
enforcedMessage: MFA is strictly required for your current request. Please complete setup to proceed.
gracePeriodExpiredMessage: The grace period has expired. You must set up two-step verification to continue.
whyRequiredDescription: Your organization requires two-step verification to protect your account and sensitive data.

recoveryEmail.title: Recovery email
recoveryEmail.description: Used only for credential recovery. It is separate from your profile email and permanent Email MFA.
recoveryEmail.notConfigured: No verified recovery email is configured.
recoveryEmail.changeHelp: A code will be sent to the new address. The address cannot be used for recovery until that code is verified.
recoveryEmail.verifyHelp: Enter the code sent to the new address. Verification does not enable Email MFA or authorize a password reset by itself.
recoveryEmail.removeConfirm: Remove the verified recovery email? It will no longer be available for credential recovery.

outcomes.invalid: The request could not be completed. Check the input and try again.
outcomes.missing: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.expired: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.exhausted: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.replayed: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.cooldown: Please wait before requesting another code.
outcomes.highAssuranceRequired: Verify with MFA or a hardware key, then return and retry.
outcomes.unauthorized: Sign in again, complete MFA or hardware-key verification, and retry.
outcomes.unavailable: Recovery email settings are unavailable. Try again later.
